brand: We’re here to help. Was this an update for iOS or for an app? What do you see on your iPhone right now?
customer: <url>
brand: Thank you for that screenshot. It looks like the update did not finish downloading or installing so the iPhone will not update at this time.
brand_reply: The update will still be available. If you tap on the update, it will still update the iPhone.

customer_message: Help me Apple!!!!! Every time I go onto a app the app crashes is there anyway to fix this?
brand_reply: We'd love to help. Can you DM us your complete software version from Settings > General > About, next to version? <url>

customer_message: updated my MacBook Air and sierra seems to have corrupted my file. Please can you help? Genius Bar?
brand_reply: Thanks for contacting us. We'd like to help in any way we can. We'd like to get more info. Let's meet in DM. <url>

customer_message: ...and this is why we pay the big bucks to . For the dock on an iPad Pro to get stuck in the wrong place. Unresponsive and unusable. Not good enough. #iOS11 <url>
brand_reply: That's certainly not what we'd expect you to see and we'll be happy to assist. What have you had to do to get it to work normally again so far?

customer_message: So i bought an iphone 4 from i guy while i was selling something on the streets, the phone has an activation lock, how do i remove it?
brand_reply: We'll be happy to provide you with our recommendations on how to proceed. There is a section in this link: <url> titled, "If you bought the device from someone else". You will want to follow those steps.

customer_message: so. i hate updates. ive rebooted iphone 6 37 times now & still the screen freezes. i cant answer calls, send or read texts, et al.this is the worst it’s ever been. i cant deal. ready to ditch Apple aftr 20 yrs
brand_reply: That's certainly not how we want the iPhone to respond to the new iOS update. Let's work together. To start, how recently did you update your iPhone to iOS 11.1.2? You can send your answer in a DM. <url>
